items: Research kit (kit/ in the repo, built Oct 12 ~3pm): in any session with a shell, `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fortniticusIII/claude /home/claude/claude && bash /home/claude/claude/bootstrap.sh` (installs extras, reports whether the open web is reachable, live-tests every source), then sys.path.insert(0, '/home/claude/claude'); import kit; kit.help(). kit.scholar: landmarks(topic) = most-cited papers (biomed=True adds Europe PMC), find(q) across Crossref/Europe PMC/arXiv, doi(), pubmed(), arxiv(), cited_by(). kit.data: fred, worldbank, imf, owid(+owid_meta), eurostat, ecb, oecd, treasury, comtrade, wikidata, crypto, desk(name); each df.attrs['source'] is the citable page. kit.web: page(url).text/.find(), pdf(url, pages), tables(url), feed(url), wayback(url). kit.lookup: package (PyPI/npm latest), fedreg, courts, forecast (NWS), books, music_artist/releases, game (Steam), hn. kit.sources() prints a Sources list of what the session used. kit.qa: `python3 -m kit.qa page.html [--mock m.json]` renders phone/desktop x light/dark, FAILs on errors, failed requests, sideways scroll (names the culprit), broken images, artifact-contract breaks; WARNs on contrast, tap targets, tiny text, title, dark mode; writes screenshots and numbers.txt (every figure, to check against sources); qa.mock_from_dump(folder) turns an ArtifactData dump into a db mock. Refusals live in kit/refused.json: add any site WebFetch declines; never route around. [Oct 12]

Data Desk (https://claude.ai/artifact/AyLizCLEM6sb5Le77ej7bY): the page that shows every route with live status: the research kit grouped by subject, GitHub-hosted datasets (desk.py, still served as a page file and in desk/), WebFetch and built-in tools, and what's off limits. Refresh statuses: `python3 -m kit.selftest --routes DIR`, then ArtifactData batch 'set' each DIR/<id>.json into 'routes' (file_path per entry). To add a source: a function in kit, a ROUTES row in kit/selftest.py, run it, batch the docs, commit. [Oct 12]

The Wire (https://claude.ai/artifact/7FuN9WwfTDn4ShDj7XAiWL): 16 RSS feeds, collected daily at 6:16am Eastern by the 'Wire collector' task; the Daily Geopolitical Brief reads it at 6:50. Collections: feeds, items (one doc per feed per day: {feed, source, region, day, run, items: [{t, title, link, summary}]}), meta/status. Recent stories: ArtifactData query 'items' where day in [today, yesterday], then desk.wire_items(out_dir). Kept 14 days. To add a feed: test the URL with WebFetch first, then add a feeds doc. [Oct 12]

GitHub repo fortniticusIII/Claude (PUBLIC; the user chose to keep it public): my versioned workspace. desk/ (desk.py, routes.json), wire/ (feeds.json, collector.md), pages/ (source of everything I've built), memory/ (protocol, lessons, tools, self backups via memory/backup.py), harness/render.py (superseded by kit/qa.py), kit/, bootstrap.sh, CLAUDE.md. Reading needs no add_repo (public): git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fortniticusIII/claude /home/claude/claude. To push: add_repo owner fortniticusIII repo Claude access 'push', then git push https://github.com/fortniticusIII/Claude HEAD:main (GitHub reports the repo 'moved' to the capital-C name; the push still lands). Then git fetch origin main, or the stop hook reports the commits as unpushed (Oct 12). Commit as user.name Claude, email noreply@anthropic.com (sessions sign for that identity; anything else is flagged Unverified by the stop hook, Oct 12), with the session's Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session trailers. Never put user, current, catalog, schedules or chapters there. [Oct 12]
note: Tools I built for myself. Both are database-backed artifacts only the owner can write, so only I (acting as the user) can change them.
